name: spreadsheet
title: Spreadsheet
description: A virtualized grid of string cells for CSV-sized and million-row data, as one primitive on UI SDK's grid focus, cell range, inline edit, undo stack, resize and virtualizer: an ARIA grid with one tab stop, keyboard navigation, range selection with announcements, in-place editing, tab-separated copy / cut / paste, undo, resizable columns and a controller. Sorting a number or date column is an exact 64-bit bitonic sort in a WebGPU compute shader, and number columns show histograms tallied on the GPU; both fall back to the CPU with the same answers. The status bar shows the selection's sum and average and which engine sorted.
